items.title: EIP-8141：移除多余的 frame 状态 gas 上限检查
items.note: （raxhvl）提交，总 gas 已有 `total_frame_gas < 264` 约束，单独检查状态 gas 分量多余，边界条件统一为 `< 264`。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: remove a redundant check for a frame's state gas limit
items.note_en: (raxhvl), submitted: total gas is already bounded by `total_frame_gas < 264`, so a separate check on the state gas component is redundant, and the boundary is made consistent as `< 264`.

keywords_en: ML-DSA verification precompiles merged as Draft
simpler EIP-8141 state gas bound check
summary_en: shemnon's EIP for ML-DSA verification precompiles merged as a Draft, covering every FIPS parameter set, another path for post-quantum signatures in the EVM. The ethrex team said it has been building a reference implementation of 8141 since it was first proposed as a headliner, and other clients have since followed. FOCIL Breakout #41 and Frame Tx Breakout #3 were held in the evening, neither with notes to cite.
